description: Gotham G2 fixture F4 (baseline rhythm). The enrolled person Alice appears every week on the SAME weekday at ~09:00 across 5 weeks. Weekly cadence is deliberate: baselines are 168 hour-of-week buckets, so daily injections would scatter each visit into a distinct weekday bucket — weekly repetition concentrates them in ONE bucket, which is what a 'rhythm' means. The recomputed entity_baselines row must show visits_in_window >= 5 with the peak hour-of-week bucket at hour-of-day 09; and because every visit is the SAME bucket, NO off_schedule_presence anomaly fires (leave-one-out never makes a regular look rare). base_capture is a Thursday 09:00:00 UTC; tz offset is 0 (fixed convention). TRAIN.
